macro.text: 10-year Treasury yield tumbled below 5%, its biggest one-day drop since the 2023 banking crisis
Oil cooled from five-month highs after Trump invoked the Defense Production Act, Houthi attacks keep supply risk alive
Gold slid to a 3-month low and is set for a weekly drop as the oil rally stoked rate-cut doubts
Japan's core CPI rose to 2.1% in September, its highest reading this year, in line with forecasts
Japan's factory PMI slowed to a 7-month low in October even as services activity improved
A lawsuit accuses Trump of illegally profiting from foreign crypto deals and seeks the funds returned

corporate.note: Stock sank nearly 7% as AI spending pushed free cash flow negative and credit default swaps hit record highs
SpaceX booked a $561 million investment gain from its Boring Co stake, lifting Q3 net income
Chip stocks fell hard after Tesla cut its spending target and Lam Research issued a weaker forecast
Cancer vaccine data leaked ahead of release, triggering a sell-the-news plunge despite a 42% benefit shown
Shares down 36% in October as bond yields spike and credit default swap spreads widen, denting confidence
OpenAI nears a $30 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation led by UAE investors ahead of a planned 2027 IPO
SK Hynix shares pared losses after the chipmaker halted its review of a Solidigm IPO in the US
HD Hyundai to build a US shipyard with Kiewit, creating 3,000 jobs

frontPage.watch: Watch whether the 10-year yield's sharp drop stabilizes and if AI-capex jitters continue to pressure chip and mega-cap tech names into jobless claims and Michigan sentiment.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3723 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.857 + 0.974×ln(VIX) + 0.312×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
